note: German framework and policy records linked to the four synthetic spaces on 4 Nov 2026. The first reading drafted 37 links. A second reading, done by the same working session, checked each link against the record text or the tagged Lehrplan wording, dropped 12 and kept 25. The 17 links to the Thüringen Biologie edition and the 1 link to the Mensch-Natur-Technik edition rest on two tagging passes of 2 Nov that saw the Lehrplan wording. The other 7 rest on the record title, summary and notes. No link is confirmed by a person. Strength is kept here and is not stored in the table.

links.targetTitle: Inheritance, Variation, and Selection Across Systems
links.rationale: Bayern has two tiers of work across subjects (fachuebergreifend and faecherverbindend) and none in which subjects merge into one (faecherintegrierend). This strand teaches one idea, selection, across biology, culture, education and AI, which is a merged treatment. Whether Bayern would place such a strand inside a subject is unknown.
